value.rationale: A first three-site sharp boundary, exact family discrepancy and arbitrarily large active-coordinate release delay answer a motivated question about substituting a one-shot projection for continuous mass-conserving constrained optimization flow. These quantitative phase results are not a routine numerical slice; they distinguish active-set timing under two natural but inequivalent algorithmic constructions and supply a reproducible benchmarking example. No claim about a full PDE solver or universal gap is made.
